adoption_status.what_it_proves: Whether the method ladder survives real photographs at all. Every method had only ever been measured on the in-repo generator, so the whole comparison could have been an artefact of one generator's statistics.
adoption_status.what_it_cannot_prove: Anything about froth. These are cell nuclei. The release gate treats domain 'adjacent' as unable to clear the froth requirement, by construction.

froth_source_search.conclusion: No openly licensed, real, per-bubble-annotated froth dataset exists in public repositories. Every froth candidate is unlicensed (Kaggle), non-commercial (Roboflow, dropped on instruction), or paywalled (IEEE DataPort). Zenodo returns no froth segmentation dataset at all. Froth imagery is operational plant data and plants do not publish it.
froth_source_search.consequence: A genuine froth accuracy claim requires Felipe's own annotated frames. Fifty to a hundred from one cell, with a known camera and a real scale, beats any public alternative because the provenance and the licence are owned.
